sources.name: Custom VN Character: HMLF001 Anime Boy 800px
sources.author: LinXueLian
sources.layering: Numbered PNG layer folders; smaller folder number is behind higher numbers. The author says some hair, clothing, eyes and accessory parts from packs designed for HMLF001 can be mixed when they visually fit.
sources.notes: The public page declares 600 × 800 px layered anime sprites, CC BY-SA 4.0, and numbered PNG layer folders. HMLF001 is a male bust/portrait-style base, not yet confirmed as full-body or independently articulated anatomy. The page lists base, warlock, shopkeeper, scarf, hair and vampire ZIPs for this character base. This record reflects page metadata only: the actual ZIPs have not been extracted and checked locally, and an end-to-end import/save/reopen test is still pending. The editor only accepts PNGs exactly 600 × 800 px to guard against misalignment.
